title: Clearer memory cards and teacher help
summary: Refined memory-card spacing, recall guidance, progress and action hierarchy, with a dedicated AI teacher help area.

changes.detail: Centered terms, added recall hints and answer labels, moved answer control inside the card, grouped full-width review/next buttons, and gave contextual teacher help a compact tinted panel.
Replaced ambiguous slash counter with localized Card X of Y text and a progress bar to avoid reversed Arabic number order.
